description: This file is a FastAPI application implementing a WebSocket chat interface with an HTML frontend. It includes endpoint definitions, a WebSocket connection handler, and utility function for authentication tokens (cookie or query parameter).

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root path, returning an HTML page with WebSocket client code.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: str | None = Cookie(default=None), token: str | None = Query(default=None), )
methods.description: Utility function to retrieve either a session cookie or a token from query parameters for WebSocket authentication.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: str = Depends(get_cookie_or_token), )
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint that accepts the connection, receives messages, and sends responses including session/token info and message content.
